name: botkins-hill-climber
description: Bots that get better with use. Quiet hooks note corrections, stated preferences and repeated tool failures; retro and curate skills turn them into small, logged changes to memory, profiles, skills and the wiki.

HILL_CLIMBER_NUDGES.title: Nudges
HILL_CLIMBER_NUDGES.description: on: after a correction (once per chat per 30 minutes) or when 5+ signals wait (once per bot per day), add a one-line hint for the bot. off: record signals only.

postInstallMessage: Signals stay on this computer in the plugin's data folder. Hooks need the Copilot harness and Node.js; on other harnesses the skills still work from the chat. Ask a bot for a retro any time.
